blind.description: A low, stylized wooden bookshelf with a flat rectangular top, decorative carved upper molding, and side pilasters. It features two shelves packed with various colorful hardcover books (in red, gold, dark green, and parchment tones), some stacked vertically and some leaning or laid flat. The back is a solid flat wooden panel, and the structure rests on a molded base directly on the floor. Surfaces are clean, continuous, and solid with stylized hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: A clean brown rectangular wooden slab with slightly protruding rectangular caps at the left and right ends.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 3 feet tall) and roughly 4 feet wide.
